description: Lifecycle hooks configuration for beznops: pre-edit slop detection, secret protection, and verification checks.

hooks.description: Guards against em-dash, AI buzzwords, and hardcoded secrets before writing files.
rules: No em-dash (—) characters allowed in UI text or prose (use comma, colon, or period).
No AI marketing buzzwords (e.g., 'AI Powered', 'Seamless', 'Revolutionary', 'Cutting Edge').
No hardcoded API keys or secrets (sk-..., tokens, passwords).

hooks.description: Runs static lint and checks for dead controls or broken caller signatures before commit.
